<a id="life-as-a-condition-of-life--生作为生的条件"></a>
# Life as a condition of life

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`life-as-condition-of-life` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](life-as-condition-of-life.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Formations and conditions are two roles of one relatum; an embodied relatum is a condition, and it arises through another's giving.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Read with one kind of relatum, a formation stands at level zero as a condition, and nothing depends on it, draws on it, takes from it or gives to it; a condition is never active, and depends on, draws on, takes from and gives to nothing. (`Becoming.Web.roles`, `Becoming.Flow.roles`)
2. So read, a web keeps support, Dependent, the renewal and consumption of conditions, the classes of formations, undermining, the living events of the stepwise reading, arising, unceasing generation and a census of the active formations. (`Becoming.Web.roles_supported`, `Becoming.Web.roles_dependent`, `Becoming.Web.roles_renewed`, `Becoming.Web.roles_renewed_formation`, `Becoming.Web.roles_consumed`, `Becoming.Web.roles_renewingIn`, `Becoming.Web.roles_consumingIn`, `Becoming.Web.roles_undermining`, `Becoming.Web.roles_alive`, `Becoming.Web.roles_event_injective`, `Becoming.Web.roles_event_onto`, `Becoming.Web.roles_arises`, `Becoming.Web.roles_unceasing`, `Becoming.Web.roles_census`)
3. A flow so read keeps what is taken and given, balance, Acting, Taking, present without repetition, the takers and renewers of a family, more without end and dissipation; the co-participation and interaction valuations keep their connection. (`Becoming.Flow.roles_taken`, `Becoming.Flow.roles_given`, `Becoming.Flow.roles_taken_formation`, `Becoming.Flow.roles_given_formation`, `Becoming.Flow.roles_balances`, `Becoming.Flow.roles_acting`, `Becoming.Flow.roles_taking`, `Becoming.Flow.roles_distinct`, `Becoming.Flow.roles_takers`, `Becoming.Flow.roles_renewers`, `Becoming.Flow.roles_more`, `Becoming.Flow.roles_dissipative`, `Becoming.Web.roles_valuation_connected`, `Becoming.Web.roles_interaction_connected`)
4. A relatum is embodied when it stands as a condition at a positive level exactly while it is active; it bears on itself when, while active, it depends on its own level at a positive need. Under Dependent a relatum bearing on itself stands as a condition while active, and if it is embodied its self-dependence is met exactly while it is active. (`Becoming.Web.Embodied`, `Becoming.Web.SelfBearing`, `Becoming.Web.SelfBearing.stands`, `Becoming.Web.SelfBearing.met_iff`)
5. In the one-kind reading of webs and flows, no formation active at some step is embodied or bears on itself. (`Becoming.Web.roles_not_embodied`, `Becoming.Web.roles_not_selfBearing`)
6. A one-kind web is itself a two-kind web whose index types coincide; what the one-kind reading adds is that condition x and formation x are one relatum, which the shared index supplies. Relabelling the condition side onto itself keeps Dependent, undermining, the living events and the connection of both valuations, and changes which relata are embodied and bear on themselves. (`Becoming.Web.relabel`, `Becoming.Web.exists_of_onto`, `Becoming.Web.relabel_dependent`, `Becoming.Web.relabel_undermining`, `Becoming.Web.relabel_alive`, `Becoming.Web.relabel_valuation_connected`, `Becoming.Web.relabel_interaction_connected`, `Becoming.Mutualism.apart_relabelled`, `Becoming.Wilting.relabelled_not_embodied`)
7. Under Dependent, a formation depending on an embodied relatum at a positive need is active only while that relatum is; activity passes along every chain of such dependence, so a relatum not active at a step ends there every formation whose chain reaches it. Consuming an embodied relatum at a need of one ends it. (`Becoming.Web.bearing`, `Becoming.Web.Embodied.active_of_bearing`, `Becoming.Web.active_along`, `Becoming.Web.coextinct`, `Becoming.Web.Embodied.ends_when_consumed`)
8. Under Dependent, drawing on an embodied relatum that bears on itself, across the step at which it ends, breaks its own dependence whatever ends it and whether or not any other formation depends on it, so the drawing event is not living: a bystander that takes nothing, drawing on a flower as it wilts by its own taking, and the flower's own last event are such events. (`Becoming.Web.Embodied.ending_breaks`, `Becoming.Wilting.wilting`)
9. In a balanced flow in which only active formations give, an embodied relatum arises only as another active formation gives to it. The formation that gives need not be embodied, bear on itself or depend on anything; where only embodied relata give, a supplied premise, it is embodied too, as a source standing as a condition and depending on nothing can be. (`Becoming.Web.Embodied.arises_given`, `Becoming.SourceSeed.source_gives`, `Becoming.Web.Embodied.arises_from_embodied`, `Becoming.EmbodiedSource.embodied_source`)
10. Arising through another's giving holds within one step: balance across the step on a family holding the relatum, its embodiment at the two ends of the step and only active formations giving to it suffice, and the form for a balanced flow in which only active formations give is the corollary. (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.arises_given`, `Becoming.Web.Embodied.arises_given`)
11. Drawing on a relatum that bears on itself interacts with each of its active events: a bee and a flower, each depending on itself and on the other and drawing on the other, renew each other, every event is living, and with no third condition the interaction reading is connected, so that living significance there is exactly a seed with both neutralities. (`Becoming.Web.SelfBearing.interacts`, `Becoming.Web.Interacts`, `Becoming.Web.Bearing`, `Becoming.Web.interaction`, `Becoming.Mutualism.web`, `Becoming.Mutualism.renewing`, `Becoming.Mutualism.alive`, `Becoming.Mutualism.connected`, `Becoming.Mutualism.significant_iff`)
12. Where each depends only on the other, both are embodied and still neither co-participation nor interaction relates the bee to the flower: embodiment itself does not enter the valuations. (`Becoming.Mutualism.apart`, `Becoming.Mutualism.apart_embodied`, `Becoming.Mutualism.apart_not_connected`, `Becoming.Mutualism.apart_not_interacting`)
13. A fox depending on the hare it draws on ends with it, and its drawing across the step at which the hare ends breaks the hare's own dependence; generation after generation arises without end, each given by the one before. (`Becoming.Predation.hare_ends`, `Becoming.Predation.breaking`, `Becoming.Predation.fox_ends`, `Becoming.Brood.brood`, `Becoming.Brood.arises`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Embodied and SelfBearing are representational premises about particular relata: remains stand as conditions after activity ends, and a condition such as water stands without being active, so neither is embodied; which relata are embodied, and whether a formation bears on itself, are application duties.
- The one-kind identification: condition x is formation x, given by the shared index type. The two-kind readings do not check it (relabel); for an application, which condition is which formation is a correspondence duty, as Embodied is.
- Dependent: a formation is active only where the conditions it then depends on support it (buffers, reserves and lags are left out).
- Arising through another's giving needs the flow to balance the web, and only active formations to give (Acting); that the relatum giving is embodied needs, in addition, that only embodied relata give; being embodied is not being a life (EmbodiedSource).
- The valuation results use the stepwise reading of living; interaction is a disclosed correspondence discipline, not a consequence of the unfolding.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Dependent leaves out buffers, reserves, dormancy and lags, under which coextinction need not hold at the same step; lagged coextinction along chains of dependence is stated in reserve-defers-ending.
- The one-kind reading keeps the listed readings (Acting, Taking, a census, present without repetition and dissipation among them), not every stated reading.
- Brood gives without taking and is not dissipative; the one-kind reading under dissipation is in generation-is-replenishment.
- Drawing at an ending is read as co-occurrence with the ending, not as causation; on the stepwise reading such drawing is not living, for every drawer, and that verdict is no valuation of the drawer. Witness: `Becoming.Wilting.wilting`.
- The relatum that gives to an arising embodied relatum need not be embodied. Witness: `Becoming.SourceSeed.source_gives`.
- Where only embodied relata give, the embodied relatum that gives need not be a life: being embodied represents standing as a condition. Witness: `Becoming.EmbodiedSource.embodied_source`.
- The witnesses are minimal.
- **Counterexample:** Without self-bearing the direct relation is invisible: in Mutualism.apart, where each of the bee and the flower depends only on the other, neither co-participation nor interaction connects them (apart_not_connected, apart_not_interacting), though both are embodied (apart_embodied): the valuations relate events only through a shared condition, so embodiment itself does not enter them, and only a self-dependence ties the embodied relatum's activity to the events drawing on it. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Correspondence.lean)
- **Counterexample:** In the two-kind reading no formation active at some step is embodied or bears on itself (roles_not_embodied, roles_not_selfBearing); what the two-kind representation omits is the identification of formations with conditions, under which embodiment and bearing on oneself are read: relabelling the condition side onto itself keeps the two-kind readings and changes embodiment and self-bearing (relabel_dependent, relabel_undermining, Mutualism.apart_relabelled, Wilting.relabelled_not_embodied). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Roles.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The premises are consistent and the conclusions attained: Brood balances, is Acting and Dependent, each generation is embodied and bears on itself, and generation is unceasing; in Predation the fox's drawing across the step at which the hare ends is breaking and the fox ends with the hare. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Roles.lean)
- **Counterexample:** ending_breaks reads co-occurrence with the ending: the flower wilts by its own taking, and the bee, which never takes, still breaks and undermines when it draws at that step, as does the flower's own last event (Wilting.wilting). Under Dependent and embodiment, a self-dependence is met exactly while the relatum is active (SelfBearing.met_iff). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Roles.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The relatum giving in arises_given is an active relatum, not a life: a source that is not embodied, does not bear on itself and depends on nothing can be the only relatum that gives (SourceSeed.source_gives). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Roles.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Every premise of arises_from_embodied holds and it names a source (EmbodiedSource.embodied_source): with its level set to one the source is embodied, stands as a condition and gives to the seed; it requires, draws on and takes nothing and does not bear on itself. Being embodied represents standing as a condition, not being a life. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Roles.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · States how significance relates to structure, for any significance or under the continuation condition (Unrestricted: the continuation of anything has significance); it asserts no significance and does not assert the condition.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Web and Flow split formations and conditions into two kinds, omitting life as a condition of life (parents and young, a forest and its understory, a community and its learners), representable only through a proxy condition. Following the nondual method (relations in one becoming first, then how actors and patients differentiate within them), this result reads formations and conditions as two roles of one relatum; the one-kind reading needs in addition the correspondence of which condition is which formation, a premise of the representation. Ren's words are “生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向” (a whole direction of unceasingly creating more 生). The author reads an embodied relatum as a condition, and its arising through another's giving, as one formal content of the relation between the two 生 of those words: the second 生, arising, is given by another active relatum's giving (an AI argument). Reading embodied relata as 生 is an AI reading, adopted on Ren's delegation (DELEGATED-CHOICES D4); it does not replace Ren's words and does not show that it is good. On the stepwise reading drawing at an ending is not living, for every drawer, a verdict that values no drawer; whether a course is worse is for the comparison on possibilities (DELEGATED-CHOICES D6). The new names are adopted under Ren's naming rule (DELEGATED-CHOICES D36).

### History

- 2026-10-09: added as P14 of the unification plan, answering H14 of the fourth independent review (splitting formations and conditions into two kinds omits life as a condition of life); following Ren's “move on to pursue the theory of becoming, and prove the necessary proofs”.
- 2026-10-09: after P15 added generation-is-replenishment, the limitations, next step and related results point to it, and the validation scope says how many theorems of Becoming.Roles belong to each record; the claim and proofs are unchanged.
- 2026-10-09: P16b integrates the sixth independent review (J4–J8, J11): the title's “life given by life” becomes “embodied arising through another's giving”; the one-kind identification is a premise of the representation (relabel); embodiment does not enter the valuations (apart_embodied); ending_breaks is co-occurrence with an ending (Wilting, SelfBearing.met_iff); the giver need not be a life (SunSeed, with arises_from_embodied); the one-kind reading also keeps Acting, Taking, a census, present without repetition and dissipation; Brood.costless is renamed Brood.not_dissipative; the existing theorems and proofs are unchanged.
- 2026-10-09: P16c integrates the seventh independent review (K6, K8(c)): arises_from_embodied proves that where only embodied relata give, the relatum that gives is embodied, and that relatum may be a sun depending on nothing (EmbodiedSun); the correspondence no longer says that “life from life” is proved, reading embodiment as 生 being Ren's; the hypothesis givers is renamed gives_embodied, and “giver” becomes “the relatum that gives”; the existing theorems and proofs are unchanged.
- 2026-10-09: P17 states lagged coextinction with a reserve (Carries.coextinct_lasts, Famine, reserve-defers-ending, §24 of the integration note); this record's claim and proofs are unchanged.
- 2026-10-09: P18 answers this record's next step ‘a valuation reading embodiment directly’ with two candidate readings, living on and descent (living-on-and-descent, §25 of the integration note); this record's claim and proofs are unchanged.
- 2026-10-09 P18b: wording corrected following the eighth independent review's L1 and L9: embodied relata are not called lives; the title answers ‘life as a condition of life’; the next step ‘a valuation reading embodiment directly’ is answered in a broader form; the Roles theorem count follows the receipt. The claim is unchanged.
- 2026-10-13 takeover reconciliation: current consolidated receipt 20261013T094743.528770Z contains 22 inherited modules; the carried-over count of 15 in the current validation summary is corrected to 22. Historical receipts and their original counts remain unchanged, as do the claim, premises and proofs.

Claim, proof and evidence unchanged. Former title: “Answering ‘life as a condition of life’: formations and conditions are two roles of one relatum, an embodied relatum is a condition, and it arises through another's giving”
